name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences

tools.name: Add asset association
tools.description: Associates an existing asset ('FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST', or 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL') with a specified HubSpot marketing campaign.

inputs.name: assetId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the asset to be associated with the campaign. This ID is specific to the assetType. For FORMs, use the form's numeric ID. For OBJECT_LIST, use the list ID (ILS ID). For EMAIL, use the email's content ID. For LANDING_PAGE or BLOG_POST, use the page/post ID. These IDs can be o

inputs.name: assetType
inputs.about: Type of asset to associate with the campaign. Commonly supported types include: 'FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST' (Static/Contact List), 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL', 'EMAIL', 'LANDING_PAGE', 'BLOG_POST', 'CTA', 'WORKFLOW', 'SOCIAL_POST', 'WEBSITE_PAGE', 'SEQUENCE', 'MEETING_EVENT', 'PLAYBOOK', 'FEEDBACK_SURVEY', 'SALES_

inputs.name: campaignGuid
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot campaign to which the asset will be associated.

tools.name: Add token to event template
tools.description: Adds a new custom data token to an existing event template for a specified HubSpot application, optionally populating a CRM object property if objectPropertyName is provided.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The internal name of the token, used for referencing it within templates. Must be unique for this event template. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, periods (.), dashes (-), or underscores (_).

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The data type of the token. Determines how the token's value is stored and validated.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.about: Numeric identifier of the target application associated with the event template. Provided in the URL path.

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: The user-facing label for the token. This label is used for list segmentation and in reporting.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: A list of options for the token, required and applicable only if the token `type` is 'enumeration'. Each option must have a 'label' and a 'value'.

inputs.name: eventTemplateId
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the event template. Provided in the URL path.

inputs.name: objectPropertyName
inputs.about: The name of an existing CRM object property (e.g., 'dealstage', 'lifecyclestage'). If provided, this token will populate the specified CRM object property associated with the event. This allows for building or updating CRM objects through the Timeline API.

tools.name: Archive batch of feedback submissions by id
tools.description: Asynchronously archives a batch of HubSpot feedback submissions using their unique IDs, which must correspond to valid and existing submissions; the operation is queued, and submissions are moved from active views without being deleted.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a feedback submission to be archived.

tools.name: Archive batch of line items by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing line items by their unique IDs in HubSpot CRM; this operation is irreversible via the API.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a line item to be archived.

tools.name: Archive batch of objects by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing, non-archived CRM objects of a specified `objectType` by their IDs, effectively hiding them from active use.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of input objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a CRM record to be archived.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The type of CRM object to archive (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets').

tools.name: Archive batch of properties
tools.description: Archives a batch of properties by their internal names for a specified HubSpot CRM object type; this operation is idempotent and safe to retry.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of properties to archive, each specified by its internal `name`.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The HubSpot CRM object type for which properties are being archived.

tools.name: Archive a batch of quotes by id
tools.description: Archives a batch of existing quotes by their IDs, removing them from active views while keeping them accessible in your HubSpot account for viewing, downloading, cloning, or deletion; note that archived quotes cannot be restored to active status.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of objects, where each object contains the ID of a quote to be archived.

tools.name: Archive companies
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot companies by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of company objects, each specifying the ID of the company to be archived.

tools.name: Archive company
tools.description: Archives an existing company in HubSpot CRM by its `companyId`, moving it to a recycling bin from which it can be restored, rather than permanently deleting it.

inputs.name: companyId
inputs.about: The numeric identifier for the company to archive. Must contain only digits (e.g., '1234567890'). Do not use email addresses or other non-numeric identifiers.

tools.name: Archive contact
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot contact by its ID.

inputs.name: contactId
inputs.about: Numeric HubSpot contact ID (e.g., '386009987808'). Note: The archive endpoint does NOT support email addresses or idProperty - use HUBSPOT_GET_CONTACTS or HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS to find the numeric ID first.

tools.name: Archive contacts
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot contacts by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of contact objects, each specifying the ID of the contact to be archived.

tools.name: Archive a CRM object by ID
tools.description: Archives a specific HubSpot CRM object by its type and ID, moving it to the recycling bin; this action is irreversible via the API but objects can often be restored via the HubSpot UI.

inputs.name: objectId
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the CRM object to be archived. This ID must correspond to an existing object of the specified `objectType`. The format is typically a string of numbers or a UUID. Ensure the correct ID is provided as this operation is irreversible via the API.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The type of CRM object to be archived. This value is case-sensitive, must be a valid HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., contacts, companies, deals, quotes), and should be provided in lowercase plural form (e.g., 'contacts', not 'Contact').

tools.name: Archive deals
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot deals by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of deal objects to be archived.

tools.name: ArchiveEmail email
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot CRM email engagement by its numeric object ID, moving it to the recycling bin.

inputs.name: emailId
inputs.about: Numeric object ID of the email engagement record in HubSpot. This is NOT an email address - it must be a numeric ID (e.g., '1234567890'). The ID can be retrieved from the HubSpot CRM email activity list or from previous API responses.

tools.name: Archive emails
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot CRM email engagement records by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of email objects to be archived.

tools.name: Archive feedback submission
tools.description: Archives an existing, non-archived Feedback Submission in HubSpot CRM by its ID, moving it to the recycling bin (not permanently deleting it).

inputs.name: feedbackSubmissionId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of an existing Feedback Submission in HubSpot CRM to be archived.

tools.name: Archive line item by id
tools.description: Archives a specific HubSpot line item by its ID, moving it to a recoverable state.

inputs.name: lineItemId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the existing line item in HubSpot CRM to be archived.

tools.name: Archive product
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot product by its ID.

inputs.name: productId
inputs.about: Unique HubSpot identifier for the product to be archived.

tools.name: Archive products
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot products by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of product objects to be archived.

tools.name: Archive property by object type and name
tools.description: Archives a specified CRM property by its object type and name, moving it to the recycling bin; note that some default HubSpot properties cannot be archived.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The case-sensitive type of CRM object (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') for which the property is being archived; must match an existing object type.

inputs.name: propertyName
inputs.about: The case-sensitive internal name of the property to archive (e.g., 'custom_field_1', 'annual_revenue').

tools.name: Archive property group
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot property group, making it inactive and hidden (not permanently deleted, allowing potential restoration) with immediate effect on its CRM visibility and usability.

inputs.name: groupName
inputs.about: The unique internal name of the property group you want to archive. This name is case-sensitive and must exactly match an existing property group's name within the specified `objectType`.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The specific CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom object types) that the property group belongs to. This value must be in lowercase and match an existing object type definition in your HubSpot account.

tools.name: Archive quote object by id
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot Quote object by ID, moving it to the recycling bin where it can be restored within 90 days.

inputs.name: quoteId
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) of an existing Quote object in HubSpot CRM to be archived.

tools.name: Archive ticket
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot ticket by its ID.

inputs.name: ticketId
inputs.about: Unique HubSpot identifier for the ticket to be archived.

tools.name: Archive tickets
tools.description: Archives multiple HubSpot tickets by their IDs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of ticket objects to be archived.

tools.name: Audit pipeline changes by id
tools.description: Retrieves a reverse chronological audit log of all changes for a specific, existing HubSpot CRM pipeline, which is identified by its `pipelineId` and a valid `objectType` that supports pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets').

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The HubSpot CRM object type that has pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets'); determines the pipeline's context. Must be a valid, case-sensitive object type.

inputs.name: pipelineId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of an existing pipeline within the specified `objectType` for which to retrieve the audit history.

tools.name: Batch archive association labels
tools.description: Remove selected labels from up to 100 HubSpot CRM association pairs. Removing a default unlabeled association also removes every label between that record pair.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Between 1 and 100 record pairs and their labels to remove.

inputs.name: to_object_type
inputs.about: Target CRM object type name or object type ID.

inputs.name: from_object_type
inputs.about: Source CRM object type name or object type ID.

tools.name: Batch archive associations
tools.description: Remove all associations for grouped HubSpot CRM record sets without archiving their records.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Grouped source and target record sets.

inputs.name: to_object_type
inputs.about: Target CRM object type name or object type ID.

inputs.name: from_object_type
inputs.about: Source CRM object type name or object type ID.

tools.name: Batch create contact-company associations
tools.description: Creates up to 2,000 labeled contact-to-company associations.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Between 1 and 2,000 labeled contact-to-company associations to create.

tools.name: Batch create deal-company associations
tools.description: Creates labeled associations from deals to companies in one batch.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Deal-to-company associations to create.

tools.name: Batch create default associations
tools.description: Create default unlabeled associations for batches of HubSpot CRM record pairs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Between 1 and 2,000 source-to-target record pairs to associate.

inputs.name: to_object_type
inputs.about: Target CRM object type name or object type ID.

inputs.name: from_object_type
inputs.about: Source CRM object type name or object type ID.

tools.name: Batch read companies by properties
tools.description: Batch-retrieves up to 100 HubSpot company records by their IDs in a single request. Supports custom ID properties (e.g., domain), selective property retrieval, and historical property values.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of company identifiers to retrieve. Each `id` within an input object corresponds to the value of the property specified in `idProperty`.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: If true, returns only archived company records; otherwise (default), returns active, non-archived companies.

inputs.name: idProperty
inputs.about: Property name to use as the unique identifier for companies in `inputs`. Defaults to `hs_object_id` (the HubSpot record ID) if not specified. Can be set to any unique company property configured in your HubSpot account.

inputs.name: properties
inputs.about: Optional list of company property names to retrieve. If omitted, a default set of properties (name, domain, hs_object_id, createdate, hs_lastmodifieddate, etc.) is returned.

inputs.name: propertiesWithHistory
inputs.about: Optional list of company property names for which to retrieve historical values. If not provided, no historical data is returned.

tools.name: Batch read list memberships
tools.description: Retrieve list memberships for multiple HubSpot CRM records.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: CRM records to retrieve list memberships for. At least one record is required.

tools.name: Batch read workflow ID mappings
tools.description: Resolves current flow IDs and legacy workflow IDs in one batch.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Coordinates to resolve, each identified by either flowId or workflowId according to its type.

tools.name: Batch read workflows
tools.description: Retrieves multiple HubSpot automation workflows by flow ID.

inputs.name: flow_ids
inputs.about: One or more unique HubSpot workflow IDs to retrieve.

tools.name: Batch update quotes
tools.description: Updates multiple existing HubSpot quotes in a batch; each quote is identified by its object ID or a custom unique property (via `idProperty`), and only writable properties are modified.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of `InputsRequest` objects, each specifying a quote to update and its new property values.

tools.name: Cancel active import
tools.description: Cancels an active HubSpot data import job using its `importId`; this action is irreversible, and any data already processed will remain.

inputs.name: importId
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the active HubSpot import job to be cancelled; must correspond to an import job currently in progress.

tools.name: Clone marketing email
tools.description: Duplicates an existing HubSpot marketing email, identified by its `id`, into a new draft; an optional `cloneName` can be assigned to this new email copy.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the existing marketing email to be cloned.

inputs.name: cloneName
inputs.about: The name for the newly cloned marketing email. If not provided, HubSpot may assign a default name (e.g., 'Copy of [Original Email Name]').

tools.name: Configure calling extension settings
tools.description: Configures or updates settings for a HubSpot app's calling extension, including its name, UI URL, iframe dimensions, `isReady` status, and `supportsCustomObjects` flag, for the specified `appId`.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the phone/calling UI, which should be built using the HubSpot Calling SDK.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Display name for the calling service in the HubSpot interface.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the target HubSpot app whose calling extension settings are being configured.

inputs.name: width
inputs.about: Target width in pixels for the iframe embedding the calling UI.

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: Target height in pixels for the iframe embedding the calling UI.

inputs.name: isReady
inputs.about: If `true`, the calling service appears as an option under the 'Call' action in contact records; `false` hides it.

inputs.name: supportsCustomObjects
inputs.about: Specifies if the service is compatible with HubSpot's engagement v2 service and custom objects.

tools.name: Create A/B test variation
tools.description: Creates a new A/B test variation for an existing HubSpot marketing email, using its `contentId`; the new variation is created as a draft that can be edited before publishing. This action only creates the variation—it does not start the A/B test or send emails. Note: If an active variation already exists for the email, a new one will not be created. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

inputs.name: contentId
inputs.about: The ID of the original email content to use as a template for the new variation.

inputs.name: variationName
inputs.about: A unique name for the new A/B test variation.

tools.name: Create a new property group
tools.description: Creates a new, empty property group for a specified CRM object type in HubSpot, requiring a unique group name for that object type; properties must be added separately.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The unique internal programmatic name for the property group within the specified `objectType`, used for API referencing.

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: Human-readable label for the property group, displayed in the HubSpot UI.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The CRM object type for which the property group will be created.

inputs.name: displayOrder
inputs.about: Order in which the group appears in the HubSpot UI. Positive values are sorted ascendingly; -1 places it after groups with positive `displayOrder`. If unspecified, the group is added at the end.

tools.name: Create a new marketing email
tools.description: Creates a new marketing email in HubSpot, allowing comprehensive configuration of content, recipients, sender details, A/B testing, scheduling, web version, and other settings; the internal `name` for the email is required.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Internal name of the email, as displayed on the HubSpot email dashboard.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Current state of the email (e.g., DRAFT, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHED).

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: The subject line of the marketing email.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: True if the email is archived (typically hidden from main dashboard view).

inputs.name: campaign
inputs.about: ID (GUID) of the associated HubSpot campaign for tracking/reporting.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Primary language of the email content.

inputs.name: publishDate
inputs.about: Scheduled ISO 8601 date-time for email publication or sending.

inputs.name: subcategory
inputs.about: Email subcategory for internal organization or specific types (e.g., 'newsletter').

inputs.name: activeDomain
inputs.about: Domain for sending the email; must be a connected and verified HubSpot sending domain.

inputs.name: rssData__url
inputs.about: URL of the RSS feed for email content. Must be valid and accessible if using RSS features.

inputs.name: from__replyTo
inputs.about: Primary 'From' and reply-to email address, unless `from__customReplyTo` is used.

inputs.name: sendOnPublish
inputs.about: True to send email immediately on publish; false to publish without sending until triggered/scheduled.

inputs.name: businessUnitId
inputs.about: The ID of the business unit this email is associated with, if applicable.

inputs.name: from__fromName
inputs.about: Sender name appearing in the 'From' field of the received email.

inputs.name: rssData__timing
inputs.about: A dictionary specifying the timing and scheduling details for sending RSS emails. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"dayOfWeek": {"value": "Tuesday"}, "time": {"hour": 9, "minute": 0}}.

inputs.name: testing__testId
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the A/B test associated with this email.

inputs.name: content__widgets
inputs.about: Dictionary of widgets (e.g., text, images, CTAs) and their configurations for email content. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"widgetId": {"type": "text", "content": "Hello", "style": {...}}}.

inputs.name: feedbackSurveyId
inputs.about: The ID of the feedback survey linked to the email.

inputs.name: webversion__slug
inputs.about: Custom URL slug for the email's web version (e.g., 'july-newsletter').

inputs.name: testing__abStatus
inputs.about: Current A/B test status for this email (e.g., master, variant).

inputs.name: webversion__title
inputs.about: Browser tab title for the email's web version.

inputs.name: content__flexAreas
inputs.about: Dictionary defining content and layout of flexible, customizable areas in the email template. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"areaName": {"content": {...}, "layout": {...}}}.

inputs.name: webversion__domain
inputs.about: Domain for the email's web version; defaults to HubSpot domain if unspecified.

inputs.name: from__customReplyTo
inputs.about: Custom reply-to email address, overrides main 'Reply To' if set.

inputs.name: rssData__blogLayout
inputs.about: Specifies the layout to be used for the blog RSS email.

inputs.name: rssData__maxEntries
inputs.about: The maximum number of blog posts (RSS entries) to include in a single RSS email.

inputs.name: content__smartFields
inputs.about: Dictionary of smart fields for email personalization based on contact properties. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"fieldName": {"value": "defaultValue", "conditions": {...}}}.

inputs.name: testing__hoursToWait
inputs.about: Hours to wait for A/B test results before sending the winning version to remaining recipients.

inputs.name: to__suppressGraymail
inputs.about: True to not send to contacts identified by HubSpot as 'graymail' (low engagement).

inputs.name: content__templatePath
inputs.about: Path to the email template in HubSpot Design Manager.

inputs.name: webversion__expiresAt
inputs.about: ISO 8601 date-time when the web version expires and becomes inaccessible.

inputs.name: rssData__blogEmailType
inputs.about: The type of blog email, which determines send frequency (e.g., instant, daily, weekly).

inputs.name: rssData__hubspotBlogId
inputs.about: The ID of the HubSpot blog to be used for the RSS email.

inputs.name: to__limitSendFrequency
inputs.about: True to apply HubSpot's send frequency limits, preventing over-mailing.

inputs.name: to__contactIds__exclude
inputs.about: List of specific contact IDs to explicitly exclude, even if in included lists.

inputs.name: to__contactIds__include
inputs.about: List of specific contact IDs to include as recipients.

inputs.name: testing__abSuccessMetric
inputs.about: Metric (e.g., CLICKS_BY_OPENS) to determine the A/B test winning version.

inputs.name: content__plainTextVersion
inputs.about: Plain text version of the email, for non-HTML clients or recipient preference.

inputs.name: content__widgetContainers
inputs.about: Dictionary of widget containers for grouping and managing widgets in the email template. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"containerId": {"widgets": [...], "layout": {...}}}.

inputs.name: rssData__rssEntryTemplate
inputs.about: The HTML template for formatting each individual RSS entry within the email.

inputs.name: testing__abTestPercentage
inputs.about: Percentage of recipients in the A/B test group (e.g., 20 for 20%).

inputs.name: to__contactLists__exclude
inputs.about: List of contact list IDs whose members to explicitly exclude. HubSpot contact list IDs are typically numeric strings (e.g., '12345', '67890'). Provide the numeric ID as a string.

inputs.name: to__contactLists__include
inputs.about: List of contact list IDs whose members to include as recipients. HubSpot contact list IDs are typically numeric strings (e.g., '12345', '67890'). Provide the numeric ID as a string.

inputs.name: webversion__redirectToUrl
inputs.about: Custom URL for redirect if web version link is expired/deactivated.

inputs.name: rssData__blogImageMaxWidth
inputs.about: The maximum width for images included from the blog feed in the RSS email.

inputs.name: testing__abSamplingDefault
inputs.about: Default email version (master/variant) if A/B test is inconclusive after the test period.

inputs.name: webversion__metaDescription
inputs.about: Meta description for the web version, used by search engines.

inputs.name: content__themeSettingsValues
inputs.about: Dictionary of theme settings values to customize email appearance. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"brandColor": {"value": "#0055CC"}, "fontFamily": {"name": "Arial"}}.

inputs.name: testing__abSampleSizeDefault
inputs.about: Default email version (master/variant) if A/B test sample size is too small for significance.

inputs.name: webversion__redirectToPageId
inputs.about: ID of a HubSpot page for redirect if web version link is expired/deactivated.

inputs.name: rssData__useHeadlineAsSubject
inputs.about: If true, the email subject will be automatically populated from the blog post headline for RSS emails.

inputs.name: subscriptionDetails__subscriptionId
inputs.about: ID of the specific subscription type (e.g., newsletter, product updates).

inputs.name: subscriptionDetails__officeLocationId
inputs.about: ID of the office location for CAN-SPAM compliance and personalization.

inputs.name: subscriptionDetails__preferencesGroupId
inputs.about: ID of the subscription preferences group for managing recipient preferences.

tools.name: Create association for object type
tools.description: Creates a new custom association definition (schema) for a custom object in HubSpot, specifying how this object type can relate to another object type; this defines the association type itself, not actual record-to-record links. Note: This endpoint requires crm.schemas.custom.write scope and only works with custom objects (not standard HubSpot objects like contacts or companies).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Optional, user-defined unique name for the new association type (e.g., 'contact_to_company_custom'). If not supplied, HubSpot may generate a default.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: Fully qualified name or object type ID (e.g., '2-12345') of the CUSTOM object schema for which the new association type is being defined. Must be a custom object, not a standard HubSpot object.

inputs.name: toObjectTypeId
inputs.about: Object type ID or fully qualified name for the 'to' side of the association. For standard objects use names ('contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets') or IDs ('0-1', '0-2', '0-3', '0-5'). For custom objects use their objectTypeId (e.g., '2-12345').

inputs.name: fromObjectTypeId
inputs.about: Object type ID or fully qualified name for the 'from' side of the association. For standard objects use names ('contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets') or IDs ('0-1', '0-2', '0-3', '0-5'). For custom objects use their objectTypeId (e.g., '2-12345').

tools.name: Create association label

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Unique internal name for the association definition.

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: Human-readable label describing the forward relationship.

inputs.name: inverse_label
inputs.about: Optional human-readable label for the reverse relationship.

inputs.name: to_object_type
inputs.about: Destination CRM object type name or object type ID.

inputs.name: from_object_type
inputs.about: Source CRM object type name or object type ID.

tools.name: Create batch of feedback submissions

inputs.name: inputs

tools.name: Create batch of objects

inputs.name: inputs

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The type of CRM object to create in batch (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', 'products', 'line_items', or a custom object ID). Must be a valid HubSpot CRM object type.

tools.name: Create batch of properties
tools.description: Efficiently creates multiple CRM properties in a single batch for a specified HubSpot object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', custom object ID), ideal for schema setup or updates.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of definitions for the new properties to be created.

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: Target HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom object ID) for property creation.

tools.name: Create batch of quotes
tools.description: Creates multiple HubSpot CRM quotes in a batch, ideal for bulk operations; provide meaningful quote details in `inputs` as property requirements can vary, and inspect response for individual quote statuses as partial success is possible.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of quote objects to be created. Each object in the list defines the properties and associations for a new quote.

inputs.about: Internal blog-post name.

inputs.name: slug

inputs.name: state

inputs.name: tag_ids

inputs.name: post_body

inputs.name: html_title

inputs.name: post_summary
inputs.about: Summary content.

inputs.name: publish_date

inputs.name: blog_author_id
inputs.about: ID of the HubSpot blog author.

inputs.name: featured_image

inputs.name: content_group_id

inputs.name: meta_description

inputs.name: use_featured_image

inputs.name: publish_immediately

inputs.name: subject

inputs.name: created_by

inputs.name: createdate

inputs.name: hs_tag_ids
inputs.about: List of tag IDs associated with the ticket for categorization or filtering.

inputs.name: closed_date

inputs.name: hs_pipeline

inputs.name: source_type

inputs.name: time_to_close

inputs.name: hs_all_team_ids

inputs.name: hubspot_team_id

inputs.name: last_reply_date

inputs.name: hs_all_owner_ids

inputs.name: hs_lastcontacted

inputs.name: hubspot_owner_id

inputs.name: custom_properties

inputs.name: hs_pipeline_stage

inputs.name: hs_primary_company

inputs.name: hs_ticket_category

inputs.name: hs_ticket_priority

inputs.name: notes_last_updated

inputs.name: hs_lastmodifieddate
inputs.about: Date and time this ticket was last modified (ISO 8601 format); HubSpot typically sets this automatically.

inputs.name: hs_assigned_team_ids

inputs.name: hs_assignment_method

inputs.name: last_engagement_date

inputs.name: notes_last_contacted

inputs.name: hs_created_by_user_id

inputs.name: first_agent_reply_date

inputs.name: notes_next_activity_date

inputs.name: hs_all_accessible_team_ids

inputs.name: hs_all_conversation_mentions

inputs.name: hs_all_associated_contact_emails

inputs.name: hs_all_associated_contact_phones

inputs.name: hs_auto_generated_from_thread_id

inputs.name: hs_all_associated_contact_lastnames
inputs.about: System-populated list of last names of contacts associated with this ticket.

inputs.name: hs_all_associated_contact_firstnames

inputs.name: hs_all_associated_contact_mobilephones

inputs.name: hs_conversations_originating_thread_id

inputs.name: hs_conversations_originating_message_id
inputs.about: ID of the first message in the conversation that led to this ticket's creation.

tools.name: Delete association label

inputs.name: to_object_type

inputs.name: from_object_type
inputs.about: Source CRM object type name or object type ID.

inputs.name: association_type_id
inputs.about: OpenAPI int32 ID of the custom association label to delete.

tools.name: Delete call
tools.description: Deletes a HubSpot call record by its ID. The action returns error details in its response when the delete request fails.

inputs.name: call_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the HubSpot call record to be deleted. This is a numeric ID that identifies the specific call engagement in the CRM.

tools.name: Delete calling extension settings
tools.description: Deletes the settings for a calling extension app identified by its app ID. The action returns error details in its response when the delete request fails.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the calling extension app to be deleted. This ID is assigned by HubSpot when the extension is created.

tools.name: Delete campaign
tools.description: Permanently deletes a marketing campaign from HubSpot using its `campaignGuid`; returns a 204 No Content status even if the campaign does not exist.

inputs.name: campaignGuid
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) for the marketing campaign to be deleted.

tools.name: Archive a batch of campaigns
tools.description: Archives a batch of up to 50 marketing campaigns, hiding them from active views rather than permanently deleting them.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: A list of marketing campaign identifiers to be archived in batch.

tools.name: Permanently delete company for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Permanently deletes a company (identified by objectId) and its associated data from HubSpot for GDPR compliance; this action is irreversible and requires the company to exist.

inputs.name: objectId

tools.name: Permanently delete contact for GDPR compliance
tools.description: Irreversibly erases a HubSpot contact and associated data per a GDPR request; if an email is given for a non-existent contact, it's blocklisted.

tools.name: Delete CRM list

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: ILS ID of the CRM list to delete.

tools.name: Archive deal (GDPR permanent delete not supported for deals)
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot deal by its ID. Note: HubSpot's GDPR permanent deletion API only supports contacts, not deals. This action archives the deal (moves to recycling bin for 90 days) as the closest available functionality.

inputs.name: dealId
inputs.about: The unique HubSpot Deal ID of the deal to archive. Archived deals are moved to the recycling bin and recoverable for 90 days.

tools.name: Permanently delete line items for gdpr
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified line item and its associated content for GDPR compliance; this action is irreversible and cannot be undone.

inputs.about: The value of the unique identifier for the line item to be permanently deleted. This corresponds to the property named in `idProperty`, or the line item's primary HubSpot ID if `idProperty` is not provided.

inputs.about: The name of the property that uniquely identifies the line item, if `objectId` is not its primary HubSpot ID. For example, 'external_id'. If omitted, `objectId` is assumed to be the line item's primary HubSpot ID.

tools.name: Delete a marketing email

inputs.name: emailId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the marketing email to delete.

tools.name: Delete meeting
tools.description: Permanently deletes (archives) a HubSpot meeting by its ID, moving it to the recycling bin where it can be restored within 90 days. inputs.name: meeting_id
inputs.about: The unique HubSpot identifier for the meeting to be archived/deleted.

tools.name: Delete note
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot note by its ID, removing it from active view. The note is archived rather than permanently deleted and can be restored within 90 days. Use this action when you need to remove a note from the CRM without permanently deleting it. This action is irreversible through the API - archived notes cannot be restored programmatically.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric ID of the note to delete/archive. This is the HubSpot note record ID.

tools.name: Delete pipeline by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a HubSpot pipeline and all its stages by `pipelineId` and `objectType`; this is irreversible, so use validation flags to avoid errors if the pipeline is not empty.

inputs.name: objectType

inputs.name: pipelineId
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the pipeline to be deleted.

inputs.name: validateReferencesBeforeDelete
inputs.about: If true, HubSpot checks for existing references to this pipeline before deletion to prevent data loss or orphaned records.

inputs.name: validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete
inputs.about: If true (for deal pipelines), HubSpot verifies if any deals use stages from this pipeline before deletion to prevent disruption.

tools.name: Delete pipeline stage by id

inputs.name: objectType
inputs.about: The fully qualified name or object type ID of the custom object schema to delete. Must be an exact match to an existing schema. Note: All object instances, associations, and properties must be deleted before the schema can be removed.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Archives a HubSpot task by its ID, removing it from active task lists. Use this action when you need to delete or remove a task from HubSpot CRM. inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task to delete. Must be a numeric string (e.g., '12345678901').

tools.name: Delete timeline event template
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific timeline event template, identified by its `eventTemplateId`, from the application `appId`.

tools.name: Delete video conferencing app settings

inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the application associated with the event template and token.

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: New human-readable label for the token, displayed in UIs and used for segmentation/reporting.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: List of option objects defining selectable choices, applicable only if the token's type is 'enumeration'. Required to modify options for an enumeration type token.

inputs.name: tokenName
inputs.about: Name of the token to update within the specified event template; must match an existing token's name.

inputs.name: eventTemplateId
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the event template containing the token to update.

inputs.name: objectPropertyName
inputs.about: Name of the CRM object property this token populates, linking its value to a CRM object property. If null, no direct mapping.

tools.name: Update video conference app settings
tools.description: Updates webhook URLs for a specified HubSpot video conference application, including URLs for creating, updating and deleting meetings, fetching accounts, and verifying users.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the video conference application in HubSpot, assigned upon creation in the developer portal. Example: 12345.

inputs.name: userVerifyUrl
inputs.about: URL HubSpot uses to verify a user's existence and authentication with the video conference app, confirming identity before certain actions.

inputs.name: createMeetingUrl
inputs.about: URL HubSpot uses to send requests for creating new video conference meetings. Must use HTTPS protocol.

inputs.name: deleteMeetingUrl
inputs.about: URL HubSpot uses to notify the video conference app when an integrated meeting is deleted in HubSpot.

inputs.name: fetchAccountsUri
inputs.about: URL HubSpot uses to fetch user accounts from the video conference app, enabling users to select from multiple accounts if available.

inputs.name: updateMeetingUrl
inputs.about: URL HubSpot uses to send updates for existing meetings, e.g., when details like topic or schedule are modified within HubSpot.

tools.name: Update workflow
tools.description: Fully replace an existing Automation v4 workflow at its current revision.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: ID of the existing HubSpot workflow to replace.

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.about: Complete ApiFlowPutRequest using exact HubSpot camelCase keys. Both workflow variants require type, actions, blockedDates, customProperties, isEnabled, revisionId, and timeWindows. tools.name: Upsert companies
tools.description: Creates or updates as many as 100 HubSpot companies by unique property value.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Companies to upsert. Include between 1 and 100 items.

tools.name: Upsert contacts
tools.description: Creates or updates as many as 100 HubSpot contacts by unique property value.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: Contacts to upsert. Include between 1 and 100 items. HubSpot does not support partial upserts when an item's idProperty is email.

tools.name: Who Am I
